newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Colombia says coffee output should increase slowly.
newsitem.headline: Colombia says coffee output should increase slowly.

text.p: Coffee producing countries will have to implement prudent policies to increase output if they want to preserve the current equilibrium between world demand and supply, said the head of Colombia's National Coffee Growers Federation.
"Now there is relative equilibrium between demand and supply," Jorge Cardenas told an international coffee seminar. "Stocks in consuming countries are no longer excessive."
"The challenge is to preserve this relative equilibrium. It is fundamental to be prudent in raising production," Cardenas said.
He refused to comment on the recent rise in arabica and robusta coffee prices.
"I would make a very bad contribution because the market would start to speculate," he said. "It is positive right now, we must give the market some space for its evolution."
